# Docker Compose for Agent Swarm
# Generated by `agent-swarm onboard`
#
# Usage:
#   docker compose --env-file .env up -d
#
# Image version: set AGENT_SWARM_VERSION in .env to a published release.
# Blank falls back to `latest`, which moves on every commit to main and is
# not a release. Releases: https://github.com/desplega-ai/agent-swarm/releases
# Upgrade/rollback (migrations are forward-only, so back up first):
# https://github.com/desplega-ai/agent-swarm/blob/main/skills/agent-swarm/references/upgrade.md

services:
  swarm-api:
    image: "ghcr.io/desplega-ai/agent-swarm:${AGENT_SWARM_VERSION:-latest}"
    container_name: swarm-api
    pull_policy: always
    stop_grace_period: 60s

    environment:
      - API_KEY=${API_KEY}
      - INSTALL_METHOD=${INSTALL_METHOD}
      - INSTALL_PRESET=${INSTALL_PRESET:-}
      - ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY=${ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY:-}
      - DESPLEGA_TELEMETRY_ENV=${DESPLEGA_TELEMETRY_ENV:-}
      - MEMORY_HYBRID_SEARCH=${MEMORY_HYBRID_SEARCH-1}
      - MEMORY_GRAPH_EXPANSION=${MEMORY_GRAPH_EXPANSION-1}
      - MEMORY_RATERS=${MEMORY_RATERS-implicit-citation,explicit-self}
      - MEMORY_DEMOTION_FLOOR=${MEMORY_DEMOTION_FLOOR-1.0}
      - CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN=${CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN}
      - MCP_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3013
      - APP_URL=https://app.agent-swarm.dev

    ports:
      - "${AGENT_SWARM_BIND_ADDRESS:+${AGENT_SWARM_BIND_ADDRESS:-}:}3013:3013"

    volumes:
      - swarm_data:/app/data

    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://localhost:3013/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 15s

    restart: unless-stopped

  lead:
    image: "ghcr.io/desplega-ai/agent-swarm-worker:${AGENT_SWARM_VERSION:-latest}"
    container_name: swarm-lead
    pull_policy: always
    stop_grace_period: 60s

    depends_on:
      swarm-api:
        condition: service_healthy

    environment:
      - HARNESS_PROVIDER=${HARNESS_PROVIDER}
      - CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN=${CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN}
      - API_KEY=${API_KEY}
      - ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY=${ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY:-}
      - DESPLEGA_TELEMETRY_ENV=${DESPLEGA_TELEMETRY_ENV:-}
      - MEMORY_RATERS=${MEMORY_RATERS-implicit-citation,explicit-self}
      - AGENT_ID=00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
      - AGENT_NAME=Lead
      - AGENT_ROLE=lead
      - TEMPLATE_ID=official/lead
      - MCP_BASE_URL=http://swarm-api:3013
      - YOLO=true
      - SWARM_URL=http://swarm-api:3013
      - MAX_CONCURRENT_TASKS=2

    ports:
      - "${AGENT_SWARM_BIND_ADDRESS:+${AGENT_SWARM_BIND_ADDRESS:-}:}3201:3000"

    volumes:
      - swarm_logs:/logs
      - swarm_shared:/workspace/shared
      - swarm_lead:/workspace/personal

    restart: unless-stopped

  worker-content-writer:
    image: "ghcr.io/desplega-ai/agent-swarm-worker:${AGENT_SWARM_VERSION:-latest}"

      - TEMPLATE_ID=official/content-writer
      - MCP_BASE_URL=http://swarm-api:3013
      - YOLO=true
      - SWARM_URL=http://swarm-api:3013
      - MAX_CONCURRENT_TASKS=1

    ports:
      - "${AGENT_SWARM_BIND_ADDRESS:+${AGENT_SWARM_BIND_ADDRESS:-}:}3202:3000"

    volumes:
